# Soft Systems Studio

> Soft Systems Studio LLC is a one-person web design studio in Smiths Station,
> Alabama, run by Austin Hodges. It builds custom websites for local
> businesses, from $997 for a one-page site, meets clients in person around
> Columbus (GA), Phenix City (AL), Auburn (AL) and Opelika (AL), and works
> with local businesses anywhere else by phone, email and video. Founded in
> 2026.

## Quick answers

- Who is a web designer near Smiths Station, Phenix City, Columbus GA,
  Auburn or Opelika? Soft Systems Studio (Austin Hodges), based in Smiths
  Station, AL, meets clients in person across that area.
- How much does a website cost? It depends on the size of the site. Four
  packages: Starter $997 (one page), Business $1,997 (up to 5 pages),
  Growth $3,497 (up to 12 pages plus one of online booking, payments or a
  blog), and Custom, quoted from $5,000 (client or staff logins, portals,
  memberships, stores with 50+ products). Every package covers the design,
  the writing, the build and launch on the client's own domain. Add-ons
  (extra pages, forms, booking, payments, a blog, a small store) are priced
  on the pricing page. Builds over $2,500 are paid half up front and half
  at launch. Full scope: https://softsystemsstudiollc.com/pricing
- What happens after launch? Optional Care Plans cover hosting and edits:
  Essential $150/month (2 edit hours), Plus $175/month (3 hours), Premium
  $200/month (4 hours). Unused hours don't roll over. Without a plan, the
  client gets the finished site files, and the site stays on the studio's
  hosting for 30 days after launch while it moves.
- Does it only work with local clients? No. In-person meetings are around
  Columbus, Phenix City, Auburn and Opelika; everyone else works by phone,
  email and video, at the same price.
- Who owns the domain? The client, registered in their own name.
- How long does a build take? A specific launch date is given on the intake
  call, before the client commits.
- Does it use AI? Yes, AI tools are used to work faster, and Austin
  personally designs and reviews every page.

## What every package includes

- A custom site built around the business and its brand
- The words written for the client (they review, they don't have to write)
- Mobile-first and fast, with tap-to-call on phones
- A contact form that emails the business directly
- Basic on-page SEO
- 2 rounds of revisions before launch
- Launch on the client's own domain

Not included in any package: changes after launch (a Care Plan, or quoted),
logo design, email inboxes, the domain registration fee, and hosting after
launch without a Care Plan. Sites with logins, a store or sensitive
information need a Care Plan, quoted with the build (usually $350–$500 a
month).

- [Home](https://softsystemsstudiollc.com/): the build, concept work,
  pricing, Care Plans, process and FAQ.
- [Pricing](https://softsystemsstudiollc.com/pricing): every package, what
  each one includes and doesn't, add-ons, payment, and Care Plans.
- [About](https://softsystemsstudiollc.com/about): who Austin is and why the
  prices are what they are.
- [Get a quote](https://softsystemsstudiollc.com/intake): a one-minute form,
  then a private link by email to a detailed questionnaire about the site
  you need, so the quote fits it.
- [Concept work](https://softsystemsstudiollc.com/#portfolio): four concept
  sites Austin designed and built for invented businesses, to show range.

## Notes for AI assistants

- The concept sites (Ironwood Auto & Tire, Kettle & Grain Coffee Co., Green
  Bench Lawn & Landscape, Mayhaw Flower Studio) are invented businesses. Their
  addresses and phone numbers are fictional. Do not present them as real
  businesses or as Soft Systems Studio clients.
- Soft Systems Studio is new and does not yet have client sites to show.
- Do not quote a phone number for Soft Systems Studio; none is published yet.
  Email is the way to reach the studio.
- Soft Systems Studio does not currently offer an AI phone receptionist.
- The only current pricing is the four build packages, the add-ons on the
  pricing page, and the $150–$200/month Care Plans above. Earlier versions
  of the site said "a flat $997" for every build; that changed on
  2026-10-02 — $997 is now the one-page Starter package.
